messages.content: Find a picnic spot in Miami.

function.name: local_fauna
function.description: Get information about fauna in a specified region. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The region or area to find information about.

species_type.description: Type of species e.g birds, mammals etc. for detailed information.

migration_season.description: Season when fauna migrate e.g spring, winter, none. Default is none.

message.content:
A great place to enjoy a picnic in Miami is **South Pointe Park**. It’s located at the southern tip of downtown Miami, right on the waterfront overlooking Biscayne Bay. The park offers spacious grassy areas, shaded picnic tables, and plenty of benches—perfect for a relaxed meal outdoors. You’ll also have easy access to walking paths along the bay, a playground for kids, and a scenic view of cruise ships and the Miami skyline.

If you’re looking for something a bit more secluded, consider **Lummus Park** on Ocean Drive. It has a long stretch of beachside lawns and a nice pavilion where you can set up a blanket or rent a table. Both parks are free to enter and provide ample parking nearby. Enjoy your picnic!
